cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(tristan_cpp VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(TRISTAN_MKL_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Audited Intel MKL runtime installation")
find_library(TRISTAN_MKL_LIBRARY NAMES mkl_rt libmkl_rt.so.2 PATHS "${TRISTAN_MKL_ROOT}/lib" REQUIRED)
add_library(tristan STATIC src/canonical/numerical.cpp src/canonical/codec.cpp)
target_include_directories(tristan PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(tristan PUBLIC "${TRISTAN_MKL_LIBRARY}" pthread m dl)
target_compile_options(tristan PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
option(TRISTAN_SANITIZE "Enable address/undefined sanitizers" OFF)
option(TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE "Enable thread sanitizer (separate build)" OFF)
if(TRISTAN_SANITIZE AND TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ASan and TSan require separate builds")
endif()
if(TRISTAN_SANITIZE)
  target_compile_options(tristan PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(tristan PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(TRISTAN_THREAD_SANITIZE)
  target_compile_options(tristan PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(tristan PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_executable(tristan_cli tools/tristan_cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tristan_cli PRIVATE tristan)
enable_testing()
add_executable(tristan_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tristan_preflight PRIVATE tristan)
add_test(NAME preflight COMMAND tristan_preflight)
